summary: The library system urges the FCC to reject proposals to terminate or limit E-Rate funding, emphasizing the program's critical role in maintaining affordable and reliable internet access for schools and libraries.

claims.requested_action: reject proposal to terminate or limit E-Rate
claims.argument: Terminating E-Rate would jeopardize school and library budgets, threatening years of network upgrades.
claims.evidence_quote: Terminating that support represents a cut to school and library budgets, jeopardizing years of progress building and upgrading those networks.

filer_raw: Friend of the Louisville Free Public Library
